reason: I do not trust a new website with my resume and my data, and I rarely pay for anything when a free playlist from my creator already covers placement prep. Free upload sounds fine, but the paid part asks me to pay a stranger for the same kind of help.
objection: Who runs this, and what happens to my resume after I upload it? A new site with no name I recognise and no track record is asking for my personal data.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing people I know, or a creator I follow, say they got placed through it and that their resume data was actually handled and deleted as promised.
